svg.title: Layered testing pyramid for AI agents
svg.desc: The widest base contains many fast stubbed checks on each push. Above it are source-of-truth contract checks, then a smaller set of live regression trials by opt-in or schedule. The narrow tip contains exploratory weekly tasks whose results need investigation before becoming a gate.

g.text: Put each question at the cheapest useful layer
real model + tools · opt-in or weekly
file exists · CI value · trial / trace ID
input cap · repeated observation · handoff bound · each push
Broad, repeatable base → fewer, costlier whole-job trials
